durations: Twenty minutes: Monsieur Félix's watch was twenty minutes behind at the nine o'clock check
Four minutes: Monsieur Girard's watch was four minutes behind at the nine o'clock check
Two minutes: the doctor's watch was two minutes ahead at the nine o'clock check
Fifteen minutes: Rosa's kitchen clock was exactly fifteen minutes fast
Thirteen minutes: the piano played from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock
Four years: the repeater has been four years of the master's life
whereabouts: At dinner, Lina sat at the table at the end, with the family, Dr Vauthier and Monsieur Girard
After dinner, Lina went up to the atelier and worked beside the master, checking a hairspring for the repeater
At the ten o'clock strike, Lina was in the atelier, looking at the regulator
After twenty past ten, the master sent Lina downstairs
Lina went straight down to the kitchen
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa from when she came down until after the temple struck eleven
In the kitchen, Lina compared her watch with Rosa's clock
From the kitchen, Lina heard Madame's piano being played on the upper floors
